# Folders that the folder landing check (.github/scripts/check-folder-landings.mjs) does not require
# to have a landing. A folder needs a landing so that its URL does not return 404.
#
# Format: one folder path per line, relative to the repository root, for example `designing-reports/styling`.
# `*` matches one path segment, and a trailing `/**` matches the folder and all its subfolders.
# Text after `#` is a comment. Entries that match no folder are reported as errors.
#
# Prefer adding an index.md or a redirect in docs-builder.yml over adding an entry here.

# The viewer API reference articles are generated for each release, so their folders do not have a landing.
embedding-reports/display-reports-in-applications/web-application/*/api-reference/**
